# Diana Barry

## Overview

- **Age:** Thirteen years old at the start of volume 1, older in subsequent volumes  <sub>[v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P22](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0022)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v3 c39 P41](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0041), [v3 c39 P42](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0042)</sub>
- **Origin:** Orchard Slope, Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v3 c1 P0](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0000)</sub>
- **Role:** Housewife and mother  <sub>[v3 c39 P41](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0041), [v3 c39 P42](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0042)</sub>

## Appearance

Diana is described as a very pretty girl with black eyes, glossy dark hair, and rosy crimson cheeks. She possesses a merry expression inherited from her father.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021)_

## Personality

Diana is cheerful, friendly, and prone to laughter before speaking. She loves reading books and enjoys outdoors and games. Though practical and well-mannered, she possesses a warm, affectionate heart and forms deep, lasting loyalties to her close friends.

_Sources: [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P22](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0022), [v1 c12 P26](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0026), [v1 c12 P30](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0030), [v1 c12 P34](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0034), [v1 c12 P36](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0036)_

## Traits

- Pretty and neat  <sub>[v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021)</sub>
- Fond of reading  <sub>[v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P22](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0022)</sub>
- Honest and loyal  <sub>[v1 c19 P70](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0070)</sub>

## Abilities

- Good student  <sub>[v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040)</sub>

## Goals

- To be a devoted bosom friend to Anne Shirley  <sub>[v1 c12 P25](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0025), [v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c12 P36](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0036)</sub>
- To be a good mother whose first memory to her child is a loving one  <sub>[v3 c39 P47](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0047)</sub>

## History

Diana Barry grew up at Orchard Slope in Avonlea. When Anne Shirley arrived at Green Gables, the two met in the Barry garden and swore a solemn oath to be lifelong bosom friends. Diana shared many childhood games and adventures with Anne, including building a playhouse in Mr. William Bell's birch grove. On one occasion, Diana and Anne impulsively jumped into the spare-room bed at Green Gables, startling visiting Aunt Josephine Barry, but Anne took the blame to save Diana from punishment. As she grew older, Diana remained Anne's constant companion in Avonlea, though she did not pursue higher education after school. She married Fred Wright and settled down in Avonlea, eventually giving birth to her firstborn son, little Fred.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v1 c12 P23](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0023), [v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c12 P36](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0036), [v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040), [v1 c19 P70](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0070), [v1 c19 P81](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0081), [v1 c19 P83](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0083), [v3 c1 P0](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0000), [v3 c1 P2](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0002), [v3 c39 P41](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0041), [v3 c39 P42](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0042), [v3 c39 P43](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0043)_

## Background by volume

- Grew up at Orchard Slope in Avonlea as the daughter of Mr. and Mrs. Barry  <sub>[v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P22](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0022)</sub>
- Met Anne Shirley in the Barry garden and swore an oath of eternal friendship  <sub>[v1 c12 P23](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0023), [v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c12 P36](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0036)</sub>

## Quotes

> I’m awfully glad you’ve come to live at Green Gables. It will be jolly to have somebody to play with. There isn’t any other girl who lives near enough to play with, and I’ve no sisters big enough.  <sub>[v1 c12 P27](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0027)</sub>

> Why it’s dreadfully wicked to swear,  <sub>[v1 c12 P30](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0030)</sub>

> I’m no telltale, Anne Shirley, and anyhow I was just as much to blame as you.  <sub>[v1 c19 P70](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0070)</sub>

> Isn't he perfectly beautiful?  <sub>[v3 c39 P42](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0042)</sub>

> Before he came I wanted a girl, so that I could call her ANNE. But now that little Fred is here I wouldn’t exchange him for a million girls. He just couldn’t have been anything but his own precious self.  <sub>[v3 c39 P44](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0044)</sub>
